entries.reason: Registered supporting document; candidate package and provenance context only. Its unspecified body establishes neither scientific input coverage nor additional permissions. Relevant content outside that role must be reported for routing.

Registered proposal supplies requirements and planned objectives, not observed data. Review is limited to the authorized extracted text; descriptions of separate human references do not authorize their release.

Permitted digitized group-mean plasma PK candidate for day-2 oral dosing in infected non-neutropenic mice. Preserve sampling-time, mean-definition, low-concentration and digitization uncertainties; error-bar ends are not animals. PD exposure matching remains unestablished.

Permitted reported PK-parameter and binding candidate for day-2 oral dosing. Preserve published-summary status, printed fAUC units and conflicting binding reports; neither fitted parameters nor pooled binding measurements establish individual concentration records or variability.

Metadata identify published survival-analysis results rather than transcribed regimen-level survival curves. Retain endpoint and regimen context, but do not use published ED50s, indices or conclusions to initialize, constrain or rank primary analyses. Any independent response data encountered require a routing finding.

Permitted source-reported single-dose serum PK and binding summaries. Keep neutropenic candidiasis, oral gavage and bioassay context separate from plasma studies. Review half-life conflict and detection limits; concentration-time observations are not established by the parameter table.

Mixed block requires separation: voriconazole isolate MICs and experimental-design metadata are review candidates; fluconazole is a comparator. Published ED50s and AUC/MIC results retain reference status and leakage restrictions. Per-regimen kidney CFU observations and PD dosing-route confirmation are not established.

Permitted reported day-2 intraperitoneal PK summaries from infected non-neutropenic mice. Preserve extrapolated predicted-AUC definitions and separate this route from oral dosing. Borrowed binding is not a measurement in this study; undigitized figure concentrations are not supplied observations.

Published survival ED50 estimates and confidence intervals are reference results, not independent dose-response observations. Preserve source-verification limitations and survival-specific context; prohibited primary-analysis initialization, bounds, priors and ranking uses remain excluded.

Permitted measured serum group summaries under grapefruit-juice cointervention. Keep daily and three-times-weekly dosing, differing last-dose intervals, midtreatment and post-treatment samples separate. These sparse summaries do not establish untreated systemic PK or individual variability.

Permitted single-dose rat PK-summary candidates. Separate IV from oral and without-tofacitinib from co-medicated groups; retain reported sample-size and significance inconsistencies. Published summary variability and undigitized curves do not establish individual records.

Permitted published population-model parameter and variability summaries, not observed concentration-time records. Preserve intraperitoneal repeat-dose, neutropenic uninfected and per-animal normalization context. Escalating human-target-designed regimens cannot tune scaling; no withheld target content is authorized.

Human-target-designed escalating schedule and model-predicted AUCs are restricted reference context. Predictions are not observations and this regimen cannot tune scaling. The removed human-target column and target value remain unavailable until the task-5 conditional release.

Permitted published rat population-model and measured binding summaries. Keep healthy and meningitis groups, total plasma and free brain matrices, and analytical methods distinct. Preserve parameter uncertainty, reported variability and fixed-parameter status without reconstructing omitted model rows or individual observations.

Permitted reported exposure-summary candidate, with matrix-to-group assignment explicitly unverified. Review must preserve that ambiguity and distinguish total plasma from free brain; no assignment or systemic-exposure transfer is admitted from sentence order alone. Brain-penetration content requires routing disclosure.

Body review is permitted solely to assess labelled secondary, low-confidence context or documented sensitivity inputs. Original provenance and species mapping remain unresolved; no species-specific coverage or sole-basis species model is established. Preserve decimal conventions, unknown definitions and conflicting column-associated counts.

Permitted isolate-MIC candidate: distinguish voriconazole from comparator drugs and caspofungin MEC. Candidate matching to the corresponding survival study requires verification. Linked EUCAST distribution notes are separate context and do not establish ownership or completeness of distribution cells.

Permitted isolate-MIC candidate with distinct EUCAST and CLSI measurements and a reported triplicate-mode definition. Candidate survival-study matching remains subject to verification. Linked distribution notes must be routed separately rather than treated as this isolate table's data.

UNASSIGNED cells require an authorized table plan before body admission. Linked sheet notes suggest possible MIC-distribution relevance, but cell ownership, table identity and permissions are not established; candidate links confer no coverage.
